definitions.short: Shebuel or Shubael , the name of two Israelites
definitions.full: H7619. Shebuel שְׁבֻאֵל שְׁבוּאֵל proper name, masculine son of Gershom 1Chr 23:16 ; 26:24 ( ׳שְׁבֻ ) = שׁוּבָאֵל 24:20 (twice in verse), of Heman 25:4 = שׁוּבָאֵל 25:20 (compare Benz on these lists). — ᵐ5 . in all usually Σουβαηλ , ᵐ5 L usually — βιηλ .
definitions.rootNote: or שׁוּבָאֵל ; from 7617 (abbreviated form) or 7725 and 410 ; captive (or returned) of God;

occurrences.englishText: The sons of Gershom: Shebuel the chief.
Of the rest of the sons of Levi: of the sons of Amram, Shubael; of the sons of Shubael, Jehdeiah.
Of the rest of the sons of Levi: of the sons of Amram, Shubael; of the sons of Shubael, Jehdeiah.
Of Heman, the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romamti-Ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth.
for the thirteenth, Shubael, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
and Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was ruler over the treasures.
